title: OceanPulse – AI Fishing Intelligence Platform
description:
• Ingested oceanographic data from 6 public APIs onto a shared 0.25° spatial grid, producing a ~1.2 GB data cube with 0% null values
• Trained an encoder-decoder ConvLSTM to forecast sea surface temperature, height, chlorophyll, MLD, and salinity 7 days ahead
• Trained 270 per-species distribution classifiers from fused biological and environmental data, achieving mean ROC-AUC of 0.832
• Chained forecasting, feature derivation, and species scoring into an interactive CLI pipeline

title: EMG Prosthetic Gesture Classifier
description:
• Built a bidirectional LSTM in PyTorch to classify hand gestures from multichannel EMG biosignals, reaching 82% accuracy
• Developed a notch and bandpass filtering pipeline to clean raw signal noise
• Used sliding-window segmentation to convert continuous EMG data into labeled training sequences
• Benchmarked generalization across the MindRove and UCI datasets using confusion matrices and classification reports

title: Recipe Rating Predictor
description:
• Analyzed 800K+ Food.com recipe reviews across 83K recipes to test whether hyper-palatable foods receive higher ratings
• Engineered features including caloric density per step and log-transformed cooking time
• Tuned a Random Forest Regressor, cutting RMSE by 30% over a linear regression baseline
• Ran permutation-based hypothesis testing and missingness analysis; deployed findings as an interactive report on GitHub Pages

title: Chassis Alignment Mode – Triton Robotics
description:
• Implemented a CHASSIS_ALIGN control mode using modular yaw error folding to lock a competition robot's head to the nearest of 4 symmetric panels
• Calibrated a 13-bit encoder reference offset from streamed live tick data
• Integrated the alignment loop into the real-time chassis subsystem alongside drive and IMU updates

title: US vs China Climate Emissions – Persuasive/Deceptive Visualization
description:
• DSC 106 group project exploring how the same emissions dataset can be visualized to tell opposing narratives
• Contrasts an honest presentation with a deliberately deceptive one
• Illustrates how chart design choices shape interpretation

title: GroceryDB – Expository Visualization
description:
• DSC 106 expository visualization project built on the GroceryDB dataset
• Centered on the finding that carbohydrate content is the clearest signal of food processing (FPro) among available nutritional variables
